Short title extent, application and commencement

THE SALT DUTY (PAKISTAN) ORDINANCE, 1948
THE SALT DUTY (PAKISTAN) ORDINANCE, 1948
(No. I of 1948)
[16th
January, 1948]
An Ordinance to provide for the imposition of a duty on salt.
1. Short title extent,
application and commencement.‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Salt Duty (Pakistan) Ordinance, 1948.
[(2) It extends to the whole of
Pakistan.] [Subs. by the Central Laws (Statute Reform)
Ordinance, 1960 (21 of 1960), s. 3 and 2nd Sch., for the original sub‑section
(2) (with effect from the 14th October, 1955).]
(3) It shall come into force at
.once.

Rate of duty

THE SALT DUTY (PAKISTAN) ORDINANCE, 1948
THE SALT DUTY (PAKISTAN) ORDINANCE, 1948
(No. I of 1948)
[16th
January, 1948]
An Ordinance to provide for the imposition of a duty on salt.
2. Rate of duty. A duty
shall be levied and collected on all salt manu factured in or imported by land
into any of the Provinces of Pakistan at the rate of two rupees eight annas per
standard maund of 82‑2/7 lb. avoirdupois.

Amendment of Schedule of Central Excises and Salt Act

THE SALT DUTY (PAKISTAN) ORDINANCE, 1948
THE SALT DUTY (PAKISTAN) ORDINANCE, 1948
(No. I of 1948)
[16th
January, 1948]
An Ordinance to provide for the imposition of a duty on salt.
3. Amendment of Schedule of
Central Excises and Salt Act. For item No. 5 in the First Schedule to the
Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944 the following shall be substituted namely:
---- I of 1944.
5. SALT
Salt includes swamp salt,
spontaneous salt and salt or saline solutions made or produced from any
saline substance or from salt earth.
For the year ending on the 31st
day of March, 1948, the rate fixed by the Salt Duty (Pakis tan)
Ordinance, 1948 and there after the rate fixed annually by Act of the Central
Legislature,".
